nodes.label: graphify query Command
nodes.rationale: Run first for codebase questions when graphify-out/graph.json exists; returns a scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: graphify path Command
nodes.rationale: Used to surface relationships between two named entities A and B via a scoped subgraph instead of raw source browsing.

nodes.label: graphify explain Command
nodes.rationale: Used for a focused explanation of a single concept via a scoped subgraph instead of raw source browsing.

nodes.label: graphify update Command
nodes.rationale: Run after modifying code to keep the graph current; AST-only analysis avoids API cost.

nodes.label: Keshali Design Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: Luxury black-and-gold visual identity built around a circular badge, gold ring border, glitter/sparkle texture, elegant script typography, and an equestrian (horse) motif echoing the 'Keshali' name; conveys premium, personalized craftsmanship for a design/jewelry brand.

nodes.label: 'Tu esencia en cada diseño' Tagline
nodes.rationale: Spanish tagline meaning 'Your essence in every design' — positions the brand around personalized, bespoke design work.
